method.registration: Direct consecutive source-image ZNCC initialization then affine ECC, not differences of center-relative registrations
method.roi: Three established QR ROIs; each previous image ROI is localized from center1 by integer ZNCC; affine displacement evaluated at that previous ROI center
method.units: pixels in original resolution; target-minus-reference; x right and y down; arithmetic mean of three QR centers
method.parameters_note: Reuse earlier implementation parameters; no new sensitivity study or accuracy/acceptance claim

conversions.scale_source: Previously reported approximate first-dataset single-axis image sensitivities; not refitted here
conversions.formula: Y_only_equivalent = dx / Y_scale; Theta_only_equivalent = same dx / Theta_scale
conversions.limitation: Separate mutually exclusive single-axis equivalents, not joint Y/Theta estimates, verified physical moves, or motor errors
